text:
evan-solutions: Quick sync — we need to lock SI co-sell routing + account ownership for Acme Corp. They signed the SOW with our HW partner next week and want a joint announcement window. Who's owning the pipeline, and what's our ROE for handoffs?

anna-partnerships: @evan-solutions I can drive the partner-facing side. Suggest we map AE ownership -> SI rep -> Partner CS. Need to agree on ACL for access to pipeline in SFDC.

raj-sales: AE (Raj) owns commercial until PO, SI gets technical ownership after kickoff. For co-sell credit, we follow the 60/40 split if SI drives >30% of pipeline. Can we confirm Acme qualifies?

acme-si-rep: Acme SI will co-host the next three workshops. We drove the POC and want credit on the closed business. We also need a 2-week embargo before public announcement.

mel-devex: Technical note — if SI needs staging access to Dedicated instances, we need an NDA + infra request. ETA for infra setup is 5 business days.

lina-se: SE handoff checklist (short): 1) repo access 2) runbook 3) workshop slide deck 4) agreed success metrics. I can own the checklist and post links.

raj-sales: Agree on SE checklist. Also tagging legal early is critical for announcement wording. @sean-legal can you standby?

sean-legal: I can review announcement copy and joint marketing terms. Need to see draft 3 business days before publish window. Also confirm if partner logo usage is approved.

anna-partnerships: Proposed routing matrix (simple): AE claim -> initial owner. SI claims via channel -> Partnerships validates -> Revenue ops updates SFDC. Quick sample claim message:```claim: SI-ACME-001; si:AcmeSI; ae:raj-sales; reason:led POC```

evan-solutions: Thanks. Action items: 1) @anna-partnerships draft routing doc + sample claim template (due EOD today). 2) @lina-se post SE checklist by tomorrow. 3) @mel-devex start infra request for staging. 4) @sean-legal prep announcement checklist. 5) @acme-si-rep confirm embargo window (2-week).

acme-si-rep: Confirmed 2-week embargo works. We'll send final logo assets by Friday. :thumbsup:

raj-sales: I'll flag the opportunity in SFDC and add the SI tag.

mel-devex: Infra ticket created: INF-4821. CC'ing infra team.

anna-partnerships: Uploaded draft doc to Confluence (link: https://redwood.atl/confluence/si-routing-acme). Feedback welcome. :eyes:

evan-solutions: Great. If no objections, we'll lock routing and announce internal handoff tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
